chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Ali ibn Abdullah, who said:

I heard Abu al-Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) saying: 'When Ibrahim, the son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), was taken [from this world], three Sunnahs were established regarding it. As for one of them: when he died, the sun was eclipsed, and the people said, "The sun was eclipsed due to the loss of the son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)." So the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) ascended the pulpit, praised Allah and lauded Him, then said: "O people! The sun and the moon are two signs among the signs of Allah, moving by His command, obedient to Him. They do not eclipse for the death of anyone, nor for his life. So when they eclipse, or one of them, pray." Then he descended and prayed with the people the prayer of the eclipse.'

key_terms.صَلَاةَ الْكُسُوفِ: The Prayer of the Solar Eclipse

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling and origin of the Eclipse Prayer (Salat al-Kusuf) in Shia Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi establishes the Sunnah of Salat al-Kusuf by linking the solar eclipse to the death of Ibrahim, the Prophet's son, thereby correcting the pre-Islamic superstition that celestial events signify divine pleasure or displeasure with specific individuals. It emphasizes the theological principle that the sun and moon are merely signs (ayat) obeying Allah's command, independent of human life or death, and prescribes prayer as a means of reflection and supplication. This narration is foundational in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between natural phenomena and metaphysical signs, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid in cosmic order.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Amro Bin Usman, from Ali Bin Abdullah who said,

‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan Musaasws saying: ‘When Ibrahimas, the sonas of Rasool-Allahsaww passed away, three Sunnahs flowed regarding it. As for one, so when heas passed away, the sun was eclipsed. So the people said, ‘The sun eclipsed due to the loss of the sonas of Rasool-Allahsaww’. So Rasool-Allahsaww ascended the Pulpit, and hesaww Praised Allahazwj and Lauded upon Himazwj, then said: ‘O you people! The sun and the moon are two signs from the signs of Allahazwj, both flowing by Hisazwj Command, Obedient to Himazwj. They do not get eclipsed for the death of anyone, nor for his life. So whenever they both get eclipsed, or one of the two, so pray Salāt’. Then hesaww descended and prayed Salāt with the people, a Salāt of the eclipse’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Amr ibn ‘Uthman from Afi ibn ’Abd Allah who has said the following:

“I heard abu al-Hassan Musa, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘When Ibrahim son of the Messenger of Allah passed away three traditions were established. One tradition is that on that day a sun eclipse took place and people said that it is because of the death of the son of the Messenger of Allah. The Messenger of Allah went on the pulpit, praised Allah and glorified Him, then said, “O people, the sun and the moon are two signs of the signs of Allah which move because of His command and in obedience to Him. Their eclipse is not because of the death or life of anyone. If one or both of them eclipse perform Salah (prayer) for eclipse.” He climbed down the pulpit and performed Salah (prayer) because of eclipse with the people.’”
